summary: Strong TypeScript/React/Node and data/AI fit. Advertised C2C terms meet the rate target. The recruiter is identified; the end client remains confidential.

pay.detail: Advertised range is USD 110–140 per hour. Confirm the offered rate and invoicing terms.

c2c.detail: The posting explicitly offers an 18-month C2C engagement.

location.detail: US-based remote candidates; some working-hour overlap with US Pacific time. Permission to work abroad is not stated.

client.detail: Retelligence is the recruitment agency. Its research-oriented technology client is unnamed; no client identity has been inferred.

contact.name: Tommy Atkinson
contact.detail: Tommy is the named job poster. The agency's official contact page separately publishes founder Colt Sarginson's email.

next_steps: Ask Tommy whether the role is still accepting applications and request the end-client name.
Confirm your offered rate, Pacific-hours overlap, payment terms, and any work-abroad restrictions.
Share a TypeScript/React product example and a data synchronization or AI integration example.

summary: Strong direct-company opportunity for Python, SQL, integrations, and AI workflows. The official application requests examples, availability, and a preferred hourly rate.

pay.detail: Paid engagement; no numeric budget is published. The application asks for your preferred hourly rate.

c2c.detail: Part-time contract with an initial three-month term. Corporate invoicing and C2C eligibility are not specified.

location.detail: Remote within the United States. Weekly hours are to be agreed; overseas work is not explicitly permitted.

client.detail: NeoReach's own careers page describes work on its internal data infrastructure and tools with product leadership.

contact.detail: Apply through NeoReach's official Workable posting. A hiring email is not published.

next_steps: Confirm the hourly budget, weekly hours, C2C eligibility, and start date.
Prepare two relevant projects explaining your contribution and measured results.
Include your portfolio or GitHub and availability in the official application.

c2c.detail: Freelancers and independent contractors are invited. C2C invoicing is not explicitly confirmed.

location.detail: Remote within the US or Canada. No worldwide or work-abroad permission is stated.

client.detail: Left Field Labs is the contracting creative technology agency. No specific underlying brand or project client is named.

contact.detail: Use the official iCIMS application. No recruiting email was verified.

next_steps: Ask whether there is funded work now or only a future freelancer roster.
Clarify the rate's unit, geographic applicability, and possibility of USD 100+ C2C.
Confirm project duration and the agency's contracting process.

pay.detail: No numeric budget is published. Ask whether USD 100+ per hour is available.

c2c.detail: The role allows several employment arrangements; corporate invoicing and C2C terms are not stated.

location.detail: The official role title prefers US candidates but explicitly allows global applicants. Confirm working hours and any country-specific engagement limits.

client.detail: Cogleus publishes the opening on its own careers site and describes work with its leadership. No separate end client is identified.

contact.detail: The official careers page asks applicants to email a resume, portfolio/GitHub links, and a short Vertex AI experience note.

next_steps: First confirm the year-old opening is active and ask for the current requisition.
Verify the hourly budget, C2C terms, and international contracting restrictions.
Send relevant GCP/Vertex AI examples only after confirming the role is current.

summary: Strong match for AI agents, React/Next.js, and end-to-end application delivery. Compensation and the contracting entity need clarification before it meets the preferred terms.

pay.detail: CareerPlug displays a USD 120,000–140,000 annual band alongside a three-month contract description. This does not confirm a USD 100+ hourly rate.

location.detail: US remote with a Pacific-time work schedule. Working abroad is not explicitly permitted.

contact.detail: Use the original CareerPlug application. No recruiting email has been verified.

next_steps: Ask for the hourly budget, C2C eligibility, and actual contracting company.
Confirm Pacific working hours and project start date.

summary: Kubernetes, AWS, Python, and AI infrastructure align well. Deep HPC/GPU operations and Slurm experience are central requirements; confirm that experience fit and the engagement terms.

c2c.detail: Contract engagement is stated, but C2C eligibility is not. Benefits language alone does not establish either W2-only or C2C acceptance.

location.detail: The posting describes a fully remote role based out of Seattle. Confirm eligible states, working hours, and overseas restrictions.

client.detail: TEKsystems is the staffing/technology services intermediary. The AI-compute client is unnamed and has not been inferred.

contact.detail: Use the original posting to apply or find the recruiting team. No hiring email was verified.

next_steps: Confirm C2C acceptance and the actual end-client name.
Check the October 30 deadline, location eligibility, and working hours.
Verify the depth of GPU/HPC and Slurm experience required before investing in the application.

summary: Potential service fit with Magneton Labs’ cloud and DevOps practice. The official Navy solicitation is a total small-business set-aside. Its description refers readers to the attached scope; staffing, contract access, clearance needs, and past-performance requirements have not been reviewed. Investigate before deciding to bid.

pay.detail: No contract value or labor rates were verified in the API metadata or brief description. This is a procurement opportunity, not a confirmed hourly job.

c2c.detail: Solicitation N0018926RL011 is marked Total Small Business Set-Aside under NAICS 518210. Magneton’s eligibility and any prime-contract or subcontract route must be checked. No individual C2C terms are confirmed.

location.detail: The API lists United States as the place of performance. Remote delivery, on-site staffing, work-abroad permissions, and security requirements are unverified.

client.detail: The published buyer is US Navy NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Norfolk. Response deadline in the API: November 12, 2026 at 2:00pm US Eastern. Recheck amendments on the official notice.

contact.detail: This address is published in the official SAM notice metadata. Use it for solicitation questions after reading the notice and its attachments.

next_steps: Read solicitation N0018926RL011 and every scope attachment before considering a bid.
Check required staffing, past performance, contract vehicles, facilities, and security clearances.
Confirm small-business eligibility for NAICS 518210 and the bid deadline against the latest amendment.
Decide whether to bid directly or discuss a defined engineering work package with an eligible prime contractor.
